subject: VPC deployment packaging — implementation credits & support tranche options
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@heliohealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procure@heliohealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private (VPC) packaging + one‑time migration credits?

Hi Lauren,

Following up from our call — HelioHealth is evaluating a Private VPC deployment for our core inference traffic (PHI-adjacent). Two quick asks so we can move this to procurement:

1) Can you outline the commercial packaging for: license (per-node vs. seat), platform fee (annual vs. amortized), and recommended support tiers? We need a priceable SKU matrix for our SOW.

2) We're looking for one-time migration/implementation credits (engineering support) to offset initial infra migration costs. What level of credit is typical on a 3-year commit?

If you can share a short matrix and a sample SOW line items, procurement will take that into our next vendor evaluation meeting (Friday).

Thanks — Sam
Sam Turner
VP Product, HelioHealth
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private (VPC) packaging + one‑time migration credits?

Sam —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary below and I'll attach a succinct matrix and a sample SOW. Happy to jump on a short call if procurement prefers.

High-level packaging options (summary):
- License model: node-based (preferred for predictable throughput) or metered consumption for variable traffic; node pricing shown in attached ratecard.
- Platform fee: annual platform fee is the default; we can offer amortization across the contract term for accounting-friendly treatment.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, included), Priority (24/7 monitoring, pooled oncall), and Platinum (dedicated SRE hours + playbook).

Migration credit guidance:
- Typical play: 3‑year commit → we can offer a one-time implementation credit in the range of 8–15% of first‑year committed billing, scaled by commit size and whether Helio selects a dedicated onboarding retainer.

I'll attach: redwood-vpc-ratecard.xlsx (SKU matrix) and Helio_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (example SOW + suggested Onsite/Remote hours).

Next steps: I propose we offer a priced option with a 12% implementation credit tied to a 3‑year node commit and a 40h onboarding retainer at a discounted rate (can be consumed over 6 months). If that looks good, Marissa (cc’ed) will prepare formal commercial lines and a counter SOW.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
GM, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private (VPC) packaging + one‑time migration credits?

Lauren —

Quick internal note before we send a formal offer to Helio:
- If we give 12% credit on year1 for a 3yr commit, margin holds if they commit to 24 nodes (estimate from call). If nodes < 16, need to tighten credit to 8%.
- Recommend carving the credit two ways: 50% applied as a bill credit on invoice 1, 50% as an implementation services discount applied against the onboarding SOW. That reduces our true cash impact while giving procurement the visible concession.
- Support tier: push Priority as recommended — includes 16h/month SRE plus runbook onboarding. Position Platinum only if they want dedicated SRE or white‑glove calendar guarantees.

I’ll draft the commercial lines and include a purchase order-friendly clay model (line items: nodes, platform fee, support band, onboarding retainer, implementation credit). Rishi, can you confirm the recommended list price for a 24-node 3yr bundle (post-commit discounts)?

—Marissa
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private (VPC) packaging + one‑time migration credits?

Marissa / Lauren —

For a 24-node 3yr commit the baseline (list) economics are:
- Per-node annual license: $28,000
- Annual platform fee: $110,000 (can be amortized across 3yrs on invoice schedule)
- Priority support add: $120,000/year (16h SRE/month incl.)

Pro forma w/ discounts (recommended):
- 20% term discount on license (applied across nodes)
- Platform fee reduction: 15% if amortized and prepay year1
- Implementation credit: 12% of first-year committed spend (license + platform fee) split as Marissa recommended.

That yields a competitive sticker while preserving healthy NPV vs. 1yr deals. I'm good to proceed with Marissa's LOE split.

Rishi
Head of Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private (VPC) packaging + one‑time migration credits?

Sam —

Appended below is the commercial option we discussed (short, procurement-friendly). Attached are the ratecard and a sample SOW as promised.

Option A (recommended): 24-node, 3yr commit- License: $28k/node/year (list) with 20% term discount → $22.4k/node/year
- Platform fee: $110k/year, 15% reduction if prepay year1 (or amortize over 3yrs)
- Support: Priority — $120k/year (16h SRE/month)
- Implementation credit: 12% of year1 committed spend (license+platform fee), split 50/50 between invoice credit and SOW discount. Onboarding retainer: 40h at a discounted rate; remaining hours billed at standard T&M.

Delivery timeline: onboarding runbook + staging in 4–6 weeks; production rollout phased across two months.

If procurement wants a stricter cap on platform fee amortization, we can provide an alternate schedule. Please tell us whether Helio prefers bill credit upfront vs. SOW discount for the first half of the credit and we'll formalize the PO language.

Would you like a short call on Monday to finalize?

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
GM, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
From: procure@heliohealth.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private (VPC) packaging + one‑time migration credits?

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — procurement reviewed Option A. Two clarifications before we present the commercial to legal: 1) Can you confirm the exact invoice treatment for the 50% bill credit (line item name we should expect on Invoice #1)? 2) Is the onboarding retainer refundable if Helio reduces scope within the first 30 days?

If you can confirm those two items in writing, we'll proceed to draft the PO and aim to return a signed term sheet next week.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Senior Manager, Procurement — HelioHealth
